output.summary: A large evergreen conifer endemic to Gran Canaria, Tenerife, El Hierro and La Palma in the Canary Islands. It bears long, often drooping needles in bundles of three and glossy brown cones that may stay closed for years. In its native area, lower-trunk shoots with single bluish-green juvenile leaves appear only after fire or other damage, and trees can resprout after fire.
